pages.text: A $(item)Gallifreyan Shelf$() works like any shelf, in white quartz and gold with a roundel on each bay. Make six from smooth quartz and gold ingots.
A $(item)Gallifreyan Crafter$() is a Crafter in Time Lord colours. Craft a Crafter with a gold ingot and a quartz.
Use a $(item)block of gold$() on a Copper Golem to gild it. A gilded golem never rusts. Scrape it with an axe to get the gold back.
pages.title: Gilded Golems
